fields.description: Must be a valid fieldname: lowercase letters, numbers, underscores only. Becomes the Supplier fieldname directly.
fields.label: Question Code

fields.description: Fieldtype used for this question's field on the Supplier form and the vendor onboarding web form. Answer Options only apply when this is Select.
fields.label: Field Type
fields.options:
Select
Data
Small Text
Check
Int
Float
Date
Attach

fields.description: Optional. If set, this question's field is only shown/mandatory on the Supplier form and vendor onboarding web form when the referenced FAQ Master question's answer is 'Yes'. Use this to create a dependent question (e.g. an Attach-type question depending on a Yes/No question) - its creation, positioning, and deletion are then handled exactly like any other FAQ Master row.
fields.label: Depends On Question

fields.description:
Newline-separated list of selectable answers, e.g.
Yes
No  (leading blank line = optional/unanswered state).
fields.label: Answer Options

fields.description: Optional. If set, must exactly match one of the values in Answer Options. Leave blank if this question has no right/wrong answer (e.g. informational questions).
fields.label: Expected Answer
